description.en: The ingest domain. You can set only one stream relay configuration for an ingest domain.

title.en: Delete live stream edge transfer configuration

descriptions.zh:
调用DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer只会删除针对某一域名的直播边缘转推配置，对已经按照该配置进行的直播转推没有影响。以下为典型场景示例：

| 场景        | 分析           | 结果   |
| -------------- | -------------- | ------ |
| 1. 调用SetLiveEdgeTransfer配置直播边缘转推后进行推流，过程中调用DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer删除配置。      | 推流时直播边缘转推配置存在。        | 推流不受影响，直播转推不会中断。  |
| 2. 推流过程中调用DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer删除直播边缘转推配置，中断推流再重新推流。       | 重新推流时直播边缘转推配置已不存在。       |   不会启动直播边缘转推。  |
| 3. 调用DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer后才开始直播推流。 | 此时直播边缘转推配置不存在。      |    不会启动直播边缘转推。  |

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Calling DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer only deletes the live stream edge transfer configuration for a specific domain name. It does not affect any ongoing live stream transfers that were already initiated based on that configuration. The following are typical scenario examples:

| Scenario        | Analysis           | Result   |
| -------------- | -------------- | ------ |
| 1. After calling SetLiveEdgeTransfer to configure live stream edge transfer and starting stream ingest, call DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer to delete the configuration during the ingest process.      | The live stream edge transfer configuration exists at the time of stream ingest.        | Stream ingest is unaffected, and live stream edge transfer will not break.  |
| 2. During stream ingest, call DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer to delete the live stream edge transfer configuration, then stop and restart the stream ingest.       | The live stream edge transfer configuration no longer exists when stream ingest restarts.       | Live stream edge transfer will not start.  |
| 3. Start live stream ingest only after calling DeleteLiveEdgeTransfer. | The live stream edge transfer configuration does not exist at this point.      | Live stream edge transfer will not start.  |

## Queries per second (QPS) limit  
The per-user QPS limit for this API is 100 queries per second. If you exceed this limit, your API calls will be rate-limited, which may impact your business. Please invoke the API appropriately.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-edge-transfer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name demo.aliyundoc.com --region cn-hangzhou
